turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Dana, Dev at HyperSale—can I take 30 seconds? We help RevOps teams reduce attrition through AI buyer practice before live calls.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: You’ve got 30 seconds, but we already have Gong for this.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Totally—Gong shows what happened after calls; HyperSale lets reps practise before buyers hear mistakes. Where does Gong leave coaching gaps today?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Fair. My managers rarely listen to the Gong recordings, so coaching usually happens after we lose the deal—but they don’t have time for another tool.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: That makes sense—another dashboard won’t help. How many deals or reps are affected monthly because managers only spot issues after losses?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: I can’t cleanly attribute lost deals to that across 80 sellers. The issue is manager time—how does this avoid adding to their workload?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: It replaces full-call review with exception-based coaching: managers see weekly trends and exact cited quotes. How much time do managers spend reviewing Gong today?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Very little, which is the problem—new hires end up practicing on live prospects. But how would I measure whether this actually improves ramp or attach rate?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: We’d baseline ramp time and attach rate, run a 30-day team pilot, then compare quote-backed scores to outcomes. Which metric matters more?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Ramp time—specifically time to first qualified opportunity—is the cleaner metric for us. But we just renewed Gong for two years, and there’s no budget this year.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Understood—the Gong renewal doesn’t overlap; it’s $90 per rep monthly, annually. Could we scope a 30-day pilot Tuesday at 2 with Enablement?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: If the 30-day pilot is under $15k with no annual commitment, Tuesday at 2 works—send the invite and include Enablement. I’ve got a meeting, I need to go.
